title.en: Friendly boutique team with rare disputes

text.en: Most reviewers praise Alexandra and her staff as welcoming, attentive, and helpful when advising on grooming and boarding. However, one customer reported a sharp disagreement with ownership over an unexpected billing increase, indicating that client communication can occasionally become contentious.

title.en: Affectionate care contrasted with waiting stress

text.en: Multiple clients describe the groomers as loving and gentle with calico cats and dogs, managing difficult temperaments well. Conversely, one pet owner felt their Pomeranian experienced unnecessary stress after being kept in the bathing area for several hours during a busy schedule.

title.en: Neat haircuts for dogs and cats

text.en: Pet parents express strong satisfaction with finished styling, praising even haircuts on difficult felines and well-groomed dogs. Clients appreciate that animals look clean and tidy, making the boutique their regular neighborhood grooming destination.

q.en: Does Le Pitou Pets Boutique groom cats?

a.en: Yes, pet owners report bringing in cats, including nervous or difficult felines, for full haircut and styling services.

q.en: Does the boutique offer boarding services?

a.en: Yes, clients mention using Le Pitou for temporary dog boarding while traveling out of town.
Most clients find the service reliable, though reviewers recommend confirming pricing and payment options in writing prior to service to prevent unexpected charges.
